title: Whole-Form Validation
prompt: Write `validateForm(values)` where `values` is an object of field→value. RETURN `{ valid, errors }` where `errors` maps field→message using the same rules as `validateField` (reuse it!), and `valid` is true only when `errors` is empty. Both fields of a cross-field pair must agree: `password` and `confirm` must match when both are present.

tests.name: collects every field's errors
tests.hint: Loop Object.entries(values), call validateField, collect non-null results.

tests.name: valid form has empty errors
password/confirm cross-field rule
tests.hint: After the per-field loop, if both fields exist and differ, set errors.confirm.
